jobs.description:
Do you combine deep Microsoft security expertise with architectural judgement to turn complex requirements into secure, scalable and supportable solutions? As Security Solution Architect – Microsoft Security, part of our Security & Networking Architecture team, you are a senior, customer-facing technical authority for the Microsoft security domain. You own solution architecture and design authority from discovery through delivery, translating business, risk and security requirements into integrated architectures across Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid environments. Your scope spans Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview. You collaborate closely with the Cegeka Modern SOC, which supports the Microsoft security stack. You work directly on customer engagements and provide specialist architecture expertise to opportunities led by the Solution Pre-Sales team.

 

• You lead customer discovery, architecture workshops and technical decision forums to assess Microsoft security maturity and clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and risks.
• Design integrated Zero Trust architectures using Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel and Purview, with Intune and Azure networking controls where relevant.
• Act as design authority for Microsoft security solutions: define high-level designs, integration patterns and security standards; review solution artefacts; and govern exceptions, technical debt and architectural trade-offs.
• Guide engineering and project teams through implementation and migration. Validate detailed designs, configuration baselines and runbooks. Agree onboarding and acceptance criteria with the Cegeka Modern SOC, including detection and response workflows, access and escalation paths, and confirm readiness for operational handover.
• Address security, integration and operational risks through least privilege, identity governance, segmentation, data protection and resilience. Define telemetry, automation and integration requirements with the Cegeka Modern SOC across Microsoft and third-party platforms, with clear ownership of control management and incident response.
• Provide validated Microsoft security architecture inputs to the Solution Pre-Sales team, including solution options, licensing prerequisites, consumption and delivery estimates, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
• Partner with Product Management and the Cegeka Modern SOC to evolve Microsoft security services, reference architectures, blueprints and costing models. Use operational feedback and incident lessons to improve designs and translate platform developments into supportable customer propositions.
• Maintain reusable Microsoft security architecture assets, coach colleagues and contribute to Microsoft technology-partner relationships. Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI security, against customer needs and operational constraints.
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft security solutions, with senior-level architectural credibility and the ability to lead customer-facing technical discussions.
• Deep hands-on expertise in at least one Microsoft security pillar—Entra identity and access, Defender threat protection, Sentinel security operations, Defender for Cloud, or Purview data security—with architectural understanding across the wider portfolio.
• Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management with Intune, networking and workload security, including integration with non-Microsoft technologies.
• Experience collaborating with SOC and managed services teams on monitoring, response, onboarding and operational handover.
• Demonstrated ability to translate requirements into integrated high-level designs, govern technical decisions and review detailed designs, migration plans, security baselines and operational documentation. Practical familiarity with KQL, PowerShell or infrastructure-as-code is an asset.
• Experience supporting dedicated presales teams with Microsoft security solution options, licensing and consumption considerations, effort and cost inputs, dependencies and risks.
• You can explain technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong architectural thinking, technical leadership, consulting, communication and collaboration skills. You balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer risk, existing investments, commercial constraints and supportability.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.
• Microsoft security certifications or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, infrastructure or architecture.

Change Manager - Facilities Transformation
We are looking for a medior change Manager to support the launch of a Facilities transformation programme covering activities across both headquarters and branches. The scope is broad and includes areas such as building maintenance, procurement and sales. You do not need to be a Facilities or building-sector expert; the key is to understand the context quickly and help people make sense of what is changing.

Working closely with the Head of Change & Transformation, Facilities project managers and key stakeholders, you will help challenge, structure and deliver the change approach. You will contribute to important programme milestones and support teams in understanding how Facilities activities operate today and how they may evolve in the future.

Your responsibilities will include preparing and facilitating presentations and workshops, contributing to training materials and communications, and helping draft content for works councils. You will map current ways of working (As Is) and support the design of future processes and ways of working (To Be), particularly for major transformation initiatives. You will also help make complex or technical topics clear, accessible and relevant to different audiences.

The role involves working with teams across four Facilities subdomains, representing around 200 people. Process-mapping and future-state discussions will mainly be held with a smaller group of approximately four to six key stakeholders. You will facilitate these discussions, gather relevant insights and help translate them into a clear view of the future journey and operating model. Depending on programme needs, you may also contribute to the preparation of an RFP.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable facilitating groups, structuring ideas and communicating with a range of stakeholders. You should be able to get up to speed quickly in a new environment, take a practical and collaborative approach, and explain change in straightforward terms. Experience in change management, workshop facilitation and process mapping is important. This could suit someone who is keen to build their experience in change management and appreciates working in a supportive, well-guided team.

Fluency in French or Dutch is required, together with a good understanding of the other national language. Good written English is also needed, particularly for preparing emails and presentations. Specific experience in Facilities, buildings or maintenance is not required.

Responsibilities

• Lead the technical development of business components for a pension application using modern frameworks.
• Design, develop, and maintain applications using C# and .NET Core.
• Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and validate them with business stakeholders.
• Analyze and resolve complex technical issues and provide second-level support to the team.
• Implement automation and continuous integration through pipelines and unit testing to ensure stability.
• Collaborate within an agile team following the SAFe framework to deliver iterative software increments.
• Produce and review technical documentation while mentoring other developers on the project.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in backend development with C# and .NET Core.
• 3+ years of experience with frontend development using Blazor.
• 3+ years of experience with Entity Framework and gRPC.
• 3+ years of experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps.
• 3+ years of experience in Agile and Scrum methodologies.
• Proven experience with WPF and WCF.
• Experience with Python.
• Excellent analytical skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with passive knowledge of the other language and understanding of English.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to work in a SAFe environment.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Partnerships, Engagement & Development Officer to help strengthen BSB's external profile, contribute to student enrolment growth and support the development of future fundraising and community engagement initiatives. 
  
Reporting to the Marketing & Admissions Director, you will build and manage strategic relationships with organisations, businesses, embassies, international networks and community groups that can help connect prospective families with BSB. You will also help develop partnership and fundraising opportunities that support the School's long-term objectives.
  Key Responsibilities  Partnership Development    
• Identify, develop and maintain strategic relationships with businesses, embassies, international organisations, relocation providers, chambers of commerce and community groups.  
• Build a strong network of external partners who can support student recruitment, community engagement and the School's wider strategic objectives.  
• Create and manage partnership initiatives that deliver mutual value and long-term engagement.   Business Development & Outreach

• Monitor outcomes and trends, evaluating the impact of initiatives and identifying opportunities for growth.  
• Provide regular insights and recommendations that support future planning and decision-making. 
Essential    
• Demonstrable success in business development, partnership development, account management, fundraising or a related relationship-driven role.  
• Proven ability to develop new relationships and convert opportunities into measurable outcomes.  
• Experience identifying and pursuing new opportunities, rather than solely managing existing accounts.  
• Experience managing multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously and delivering against agreed objectives.  
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data and insights to inform decisions and improve performance.  
• Experience forecasting outcomes, identifying risks and taking proactive action to maintain progress.  
• Strong stakeholder-management, networking, influencing and relationship-building skills.  
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.  
• Excellent organisational, communication and presentation skills.  
• Excellent spoken and written English.      
Desirable
    
• Experience working with international organisations, multinational companies, embassies, diplomatic communities, relocation organisations or professional networks.  
• An established professional network within Belgium and/or relevant international communities.  
• Experience in fundraising, sponsorship, philanthropy or corporate partnerships.  
• Experience within education, international education or another relationship-driven environment.  
• Experience supporting student recruitment, admissions, customer acquisition or business growth activities.  
• French and/or Dutch language skills.   Candidate Profile    
• Commercial focus: Understands how strong relationships translate into tangible outcomes and sustainable growth.  
• Business development instinct: Enjoys creating opportunities, opening doors and building new connections.  
• Relationship builder: Establishes credibility quickly and develops trusted relationships across cultures, sectors and levels of seniority.  
• Strategic thinker: Able to identify opportunities, assess priorities and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.  
• Results-oriented: Takes ownership, follows through and delivers against agreed objectives.  
• Analytical: Uses evidence, insight and good judgement to inform decisions and recommend action.  
• Resilient and proactive: Maintains momentum, follows up consistently and remains focused on long-term goals.  
• Collaborative: Works effectively with colleagues across functions to achieve shared objectives.  
• Professional and discreet: Exercises sound judgement and represents BSB with credibility and integrity.  
• International mindset: Values diversity and thrives in an international and multilingual environment.   What Success Looks Like    
• Development of a strong portfolio of active strategic partnerships.  
• Increased awareness of BSB amongst key external audiences and communities.  
• A measurable contribution to enrolment growth through partnership and outreach activities.  
• Growth in fundraising, sponsorship or development opportunities.  
• Strong engagement and retention of key partners and stakeholders.  
• Effective identification and progression of new opportunities and networks.

Your responsibilities include:
  
Production & Planning
    
• Organize and coordinate the daily operations of the cutting, deboning, and packaging processes based on customer orders.  
• Monitor productivity, carcass yield, and production lead times, taking corrective action where necessary.  
• Coordinate production activities with sales and transport to ensure daily deliveries leave on time.   
 
  
People Management
    
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 15 employees, including butchers, meat cutters, packers, and drivers.  
• Prepare staff schedules and monitor attendance, leave, and training.  
• Participate in the recruitment, onboarding, and evaluation of new employees.   
 
  
Quality & Food Safety
    
• Work together with the quality department to ensure the site complies with IFS, ACS, and FASFC regulations.  
• Monitor hygiene, cold chain management, and traceability on the production floor and take action when deviations occur.  
• Assist in preparing for audits and inspections and follow up on corrective actions.   
 
  
Infrastructure, Maintenance & Safety
    
• Take responsibility for buildings, refrigeration systems, machinery, and production lines.  
• Coordinate maintenance and repairs with internal technicians and external partners.  
• Ensure workplace safety, employee well-being, and good housekeeping standards.   
 
  
Transport & Logistics
    
• Manage the company's fleet of refrigerated trucks and the drivers.  
• Organize daily route planning to ensure every delivery reaches the customer on time and in full.  
• Monitor cold chain compliance during transport and oversee fleet maintenance, inspections, and legal requirements.   
 
  
Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
    
• Monitor KPIs (yield, productivity, costs, complaints, and waste) and report to management. 
  
• Bachelor's degree level or equivalent through experience.  
• At least 5 years of experience in a management role within production, preferably in the meat or food industry.  
• Practical experience with food safety standards (IFS, HACCP, ACS, FASFC) and audit processes.  
• Hands-on leader: visible on the shop floor and capable of motivating a team of skilled professionals.  
• Stress-resistant and decisive: able to maintain oversight in a fast-paced production environment with demanding delivery schedules.  
• Structured, with a strong focus on numbers, processes, and continuous improvement.  
• Fluent in Dutch and English. Additional languages are considered an asset in our multilingual team.  
• Flexible: willing to start early when required to oversee production at the beginning of the shift. Production starts at 3:00 a.m.

As a Customer Service Officer you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you? • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate) • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus • You are flexible and customer-oriented • You live in the Geel region • You perform physical work with a smile • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian • Living in the Geel region
